subproblem.title: Varifold tangents 8.5.1–5.4 (corrected 5.2, 5.3) and the blow-up density lower bound used in 5.5/5.7
subproblem.statement: (A, Simon 8.5.1–5.4 corrected) If V has locally bounded first variation in U, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, Θ^n(μ_V,x) = θ0 and ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, then every sequence λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0 has a subsequence along which the rescalings V_{x,λ_j} = rescaledMeasure V x λ_j converge vaguely (against C_c(ℝ^N × G)) to some n-varifold C on ℝ^N; and every such limit C (IsVarifoldTangent V x C) is stationary in ℝ^N, satisfies μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0 ω_n ρ^n for all ρ > 0, and μ_C(sA) = s^n μ_C(A) for all s > 0 and A ⊆ ℝ^N (this is VarifoldTangentCones). (B, the use of 3.7 in 5.5 and 5.7) If V has locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, τ > 0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ τ)}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, then for every varifold tangent C of V at x, Θ^n(μ_C,y) exists and is ≥ τ for μ_C-a.e. y.
subproblem.lean_statement: VarifoldTangentCones ∧ ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → 0 < τ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon, Ch. 8, 5.1–5.4 and the surrounding printed argument (p. 215), the extraction via “the Compactness Theorem 4.16 of Ch. 1”, the stationarity “by definition of δV (in 2)”, 5.2 and 3.4 for radial rigidity, and “the same argument as in the proof of Theorem 6.1 of Ch. 4, except that we use 3.5” for homogeneity; and, for the second conjunct, the blow-up use of the semicontinuity theorem 3.7 made in the proofs of 5.5 (steps (3)–(7)) and 5.7. ERRATA: (5.2) printed μ_C(B_ρ(x)) must read μ_C(B_ρ(0)); (5.3) printed λ^{-n}μ_C(η_{0,λ}(A)) = μ_C(A) has the wrong power — the correct homogeneity is μ_C(sA) = s^n μ_C(A) (SimonGMT TangentScalingCounterexample); (3.5) the sign in front of δV(X) is “−” (SimonGMT WeightedRadialIdentity.lean header) — irrelevant here since δC = 0; the cited “Theorem 6.1 of Ch. 4” is not present in this edition, so the homogeneity argument is written out in step A5 (it is 3.5 with V = C, x = 0, ρ so large that φ(r/ρ) ≡ 1 on spt h). In the proof of 5.5, printed (5) “Θ^n(μ_{V_j}, y) ≤ θ0 − ε_j” must read “≥”. Notation: G = Grassmannian N n; μ_W = W.weight; ‖δV‖ = variationMeasure V; B_ρ(y) closed ball, B°_ρ(y) open ball; V_{x,t} := rescaledMeasure V x t = t^{-n}·η_{x,t#}V with η_{x,t}(z,S) = ((z−x)/t, S); ω_n = unitBallVolume n; “→” between measures on ℝ^N × G means VagueConverges (convergence of ∫ f for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G)).

PRELIMINARY FACTS (used repeatedly).
R1 (rescaled masses). For t, R > 0: V_{x,t}(B_R(0) × G) = t^{-n} μ_V(B_{tR}(x)) = ω_n R^n · densityRatio n μ_V x (tR). (Measure.map_apply; the preimage of B_R(0) × G is B_{tR}(x) × G; SimonGMT blowUpWeight_closedBall, TangentRescaling.lean:119, rescaledMeasure V x t being V.blowUpMeasure x t by unfolding.)
R2 (first variation scaling). For X ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N;ℝ^N) with tsupport X ⊆ B°_R(0) and t > 0 with B_{tR}(x) ⊆ U, put Y(z) := t X((z−x)/t); then DY(z) = DX((z−x)/t), Y ∈ K(U;ℝ^N), tsupport Y ⊆ B°_{tR}(x) and ∫ div_S X dV_{x,t} = t^{-n} ∫ div_S X((z−x)/t) dV(z,S) = t^{-n} δV(Y). By 2.6 (sibling first_variation: δV(Y) = −∫ν·Y d‖δV‖, |ν| = 1), |δV(Y)| ≤ sup|Y| ‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)) = t sup|X| ‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)). Hence |∫ div_S X dV_{x,t}| ≤ sup|X| R^{n−1} (tR)^{1−n} ‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)).
R3 (portmanteau for weights). If W_j → W vaguely on ℝ^N × G then μ_{W_j} → μ_W against C_c(ℝ^N) (lift g to (y,S) ↦ g(y), compactly supported because G is compact), hence μ_W(O) ≤ liminf μ_{W_j}(O) for open O and μ_W(K) ≥ limsup μ_{W_j}(K) for compact K; more generally ∫ F dW_j → ∫ F dW for bounded Borel F with compact support whose discontinuity set is W-null.

PART A: VarifoldTangentCones. Hypotheses: V has LBFV, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, HasDensity n μ_V x θ0, and (5.1) ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) = ofReal ρ · ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/ofReal ρ^n → 0 as ρ ↓ 0.
A1 (extraction; printed “by the Compactness Theorem 4.16 of Ch. 1”). Let t_j > 0, t_j → 0. For compact K ⊆ ℝ^N choose R with K ⊆ B_R(0); by R1 and HasDensity, V_{x,t_j}(K × G) ≤ ω_n R^n densityRatio(t_jR) → θ0 ω_n R^n, so V_{x,t_j}(K × G) ≤ θ0ω_nR^n + 1 for j large. The sibling radon_compactness (with U := ℝ^N = univ, μ_j := V_{x,t_j}) gives a strictly increasing φ and C : Varifold N n univ with ∫ f dV_{x,t_{φ(j)}} → ∫ f dC for all f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) (the support condition tsupport f ⊆ univ × G is automatic), i.e. VagueConverges. This is conclusion (a).
Now let C be any varifold tangent: t_j > 0, t_j → 0 (not necessarily monotone) and V_j := V_{x,t_j} → C.
A2 (C is stationary; printed “by definition of δV”). For X ∈ K(ℝ^N;ℝ^N), div_S X(y) is continuous with compact support in ℝ^N × G (SimonGMT continuous_tangentialDivergence, hasCompactSupport_tangentialDivergence), so δC(X) = lim_j ∫ div_S X dV_j. Choose R with tsupport X ⊆ B°_R(0); for j large B_{t_jR}(x) ⊆ U and by R2, |∫ div_S X dV_j| ≤ sup|X| R^{n−1} (t_jR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{t_jR}(x)) → 0 by (5.1). Hence δC(X) = 0, C.Stationary.
A3 (5.2, corrected centre 0). Fix ρ > 0. By R1, μ_{V_j}(B_ρ(0)) = ω_nρ^n densityRatio(t_jρ) → θ0 ω_n ρ^n (also for every ρ' > 0). By R3: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) ≥ limsup μ_{V_j}(B_ρ(0)) = θ0ω_nρ^n; and for every ρ' > ρ, μ_C(B_ρ(0)) ≤ μ_C(B°_{ρ'}(0)) ≤ liminf μ_{V_j}(B°_{ρ'}(0)) ≤ lim μ_{V_j}(B_{ρ'}(0)) = θ0ω_nρ'^n; letting ρ' ↓ ρ gives equality: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0 ω_n ρ^n for all ρ > 0 (in ℝ≥0∞: ofReal θ0 · unitBallVolume n · ofReal ρ ^ n).
A4 (radial rigidity; printed “Since δC = 0 we can use 5.2 together with 3.4”). C is stationary on ℝ^N, so the sibling monotonicity_density (second conjunct StationaryMonotonicityIdentity, with U = ℝ^N, centre 0, any ρ0) gives Θ^n(μ_C,0) + ω_n^{-1} normalDefect C 0 (B_ρ(0)) = densityRatio n μ_C 0 ρ = θ0 for all ρ > 0, and Θ^n(μ_C, 0) = lim densityRatio = θ0 (finite). So ∫_{Gₙ(B_ρ(0))} |p_{S⊥}(y)|²/|y|^{n+2} dC = 0 for all ρ, hence p_{S⊥}(y) = 0 for C-a.e. (y,S), and since (y,S) ↦ p_{S⊥}(y) is continuous, p_{S⊥}(y) = 0, i.e. y ∈ S, for every (y,S) ∈ spt C. (Formal: SimonGMT Stationary.radial_mem_plane_of_mem_support_of_constant_mass_ratio, TangentRadialRigidity.lean:122, whose mass hypothesis is A3 in the normalisation μ_C(B_R(0))/ofReal(R^n) = θ0ω_n.)
A5 (homogeneity, corrected 5.3). Let g ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N) and X(y) := g(y) y ∈ K(ℝ^N;ℝ^N). For S ∈ G: div_S X(y) = g(y) trace(p_S) + ⟨p_S(y), ∇g(y)⟩ = n g(y) + ⟨p_S(y), ∇g(y)⟩ (SimonGMT tangentialDivergence_smul, RadialFirstVariation.lean:257). On spt C, p_S(y) = y by A4, and C is carried by spt C, so stationarity gives
 (H) ∫ (n g(y) + ⟨y, ∇g(y)⟩) dμ_C(y) = 0 for every g ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N).
 (This is 3.5 for V = C at x = 0 with h = g and φ(r/ρ) ≡ 1 on spt g: the defect term vanishes by A4, δC = 0, and ∇^S g·y = ∇g·p_S(y) = ∇g·y.) For s > 0 put F(s) := ∫ g(y/s) dμ_C(y). Differentiating under the integral (g ∈ C¹_c; for s in a compact subinterval of (0,∞) the integrands are supported in a fixed compact set and uniformly bounded; μ_C is finite on compacts), F'(s) = −s^{-1} ∫ ⟨y/s, ∇g(y/s)⟩ dμ_C(y). Applying (H) to g_s := g(·/s) (∇g_s(y) = s^{-1}∇g(y/s)) gives ∫ ⟨y/s, ∇g(y/s)⟩ dμ_C = −n F(s), so F'(s) = n F(s)/s and d/ds(s^{-n}F(s)) = 0. Hence ∫ g(y/s) dμ_C(y) = s^n ∫ g dμ_C for all s > 0 and g ∈ C¹_c(ℝ^N), and by uniform approximation (C¹_c is dense in C_c in sup norm with supports in a fixed compact set; μ_C is finite on compacts) for all g ∈ C_c(ℝ^N). Both (y ↦ y/s)_#μ_C and s^n μ_C are locally finite, hence regular, Borel measures on ℝ^N with the same integrals on C_c, so they are equal (Riesz uniqueness; Mathlib Measure.ext_of_integral_eq_on_compactlySupported). Since y ↦ y/s is a measurable equivalence (homeomorphism), Measure.map_apply holds for every set: μ_C(s • A) = ((y ↦ y/s)_#μ_C)(A) = s^n μ_C(A) for all A ⊆ ℝ^N (outer measure), i.e. C.weight (s • A) = ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A.
 A2–A5 give conclusion (b). This proves VarifoldTangentCones.

PART B: blow-up density lower bound (the use of 3.7 in the proofs of 5.5 (3)–(7) and 5.7). Hypotheses: V has LBFV, x ∈ U, τ > 0, (5.1) as above, and
 (E) ρ^{-n} μ_V(E ∩ B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, where E := {y : ¬ ∃ θ, HasDensity n μ_V y θ ∧ ofReal τ ≤ θ} (outer measure; E need not be measurable).
Claim: for every C : Varifold N n univ with IsVarifoldTangent V x C, for μ_C-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_C, y) exists and is ≥ τ.
B1 (restricted rescalings). Let t_j > 0, t_j → 0, V_{x,t_j} → C. Fix R ∈ ℕ_{≥1} and j0 with B_{t_j R}(x) ⊆ U for j ≥ j0. For j ≥ j0 let W_j be the n-varifold on Ω := B°_R(0) with measure V_{x,t_j} ⌞ (Ω × G) (vanishes off Ω × G; finite on K × G for compact K ⊆ Ω by R1), and C_Ω the varifold on Ω with measure C ⌞ (Ω × G). Also let W'_j, C'_Ω be the same varifolds with measures multiplied by τ^{-1} (a positive multiple of a varifold is a varifold; LBFV, variationMeasure and density scale by τ^{-1}; HasDensity n (τ^{-1}μ) y θ ⇔ HasDensity n μ y (τθ)).
B2 (convergence on Ω). Every f ∈ C_c(Ω × G) (subtype) extends by zero to f̃ ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) with tsupport ⊆ Ω × G, and ∫ f d(W_j)_dom = ∫ f̃ dV_{x,t_j} → ∫ f̃ dC = ∫ f d(C_Ω)_dom. So (W'_{j0+i})_i RadonConverges to C'_Ω.
B3 (first variation of W_j). For X ∈ K(Ω;ℝ^N), δW_j(X) = ∫ div_S X dV_{x,t_j} (div_S X vanishes off Ω × G), so by R2 with tsupport X ⊆ Ω: |δW_j(X)| ≤ sup|X| R^{n−1} (t_jR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{t_jR}(x)). Hence firstVariationNormOn W_j O ≤ R^{n−1}(t_jR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{t_jR}(x)) < ∞ for every O, so W_j has LBFV, and for open O ⊂⊂ Ω (sibling first_variation, 2.5) ‖δW_j‖(O) = firstVariationNormOn W_j O → 0 as j → ∞ by (5.1). In particular liminf_j ‖δW'_j‖(O) = 0 < ∞.
B4 (densities). For y ∈ Ω and ρ small (B_ρ(y) ⊆ Ω): μ_{W_j}(B_ρ(y)) = t_j^{-n} μ_V(B_{t_jρ}(x + t_j y)) (R1 recentred), so densityRatio n μ_{W_j} y ρ = densityRatio n μ_V (x + t_j y) (t_jρ); hence HasDensity n μ_{W_j} y θ ⇔ HasDensity n μ_V (x + t_jy) θ. Put B_j := {y ∈ Ω : x + t_j y ∈ E}. For y ∈ Ω ∖ B_j, Θ^n(μ_{W'_j}, y) exists and is ≥ 1. For W' ⊂⊂ Ω: μ_{W'_j}(B_j ∩ W') ≤ τ^{-1} t_j^{-n} μ_V(E ∩ B_{t_jR}(x)) = τ^{-1}R^n (t_jR)^{-n}μ_V(E ∩ B_{t_jR}(x)) → 0 by (E).
B5 (apply 3.7). The sibling density_semicontinuity (DensitySemicontinuity) applied on Ω to (W'_{j0+i})_i → C'_Ω with the sets B_{j0+i} yields: for μ_{C'_Ω}-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_{C'_Ω}, y) exists and is ≥ 1, i.e. for μ_C-a.e. y ∈ Ω = B°_R(0), Θ^n(μ_C, y) exists and is ≥ τ (for y ∈ Ω, small balls about y lie in Ω, so densities of C_Ω and C at y coincide; ofReal scaling by τ).
B6. Taking the union over R ∈ ℕ of the exceptional μ_C-null sets gives the claim on all of ℝ^N. This proves the second conjunct.
proof_key_steps: Rescaled masses: V_{x,t}(B_R(0)×G) = ω_nR^n densityRatio(tR) → θ0ω_nR^n; radon_compactness with U = ℝ^N gives the extraction (a).
First-variation scaling ∫div_S X dV_{x,t} = t^{-n}δV(t X((·−x)/t)), bounded by sup|X|R^{n−1}(tR)^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_{tR}(x)) → 0: C is stationary.
Portmanteau on closed/open balls: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0ω_nρ^n for every ρ (corrected centre 0).
3.4 at 0 with constant ratio: zero normal defect, so y ∈ S on spt C (SimonGMT radial rigidity).
Stationarity with X = g(y)y gives ∫(ng + y·∇g)dμ_C = 0; d/ds(s^{-n}∫g(y/s)dμ_C) = 0; Riesz uniqueness and the homeomorphism y ↦ y/s give μ_C(sA) = s^nμ_C(A) for all A (corrected 5.3).

(B) Restrict the rescalings to B°_R(0), scale by τ^{-1}: they are varifolds with ‖δ‖ → 0, densities transported from V, exceptional sets of vanishing mass; Theorem 3.7 (density_semicontinuity) on B°_R(0); union over R.

subproblem.title: Allard's Rectifiability Theorem 8.5.5 with Remark 5.6, and Corollary 8.5.7 (tangent cones are rectifiable cones)
subproblem.statement: If V has locally bounded first variation in open U ⊆ ℝ^N and Θ^n(μ_V,x) exists and is > 0 for μ_V-a.e. x, then V is rectifiable (IsRectifiable V: V = v(M,θ) for some M, θ) and V has a tangent plane with positive multiplicity in the sense of Def. 1.1 at μ_V-a.e. x. Moreover (Simon 5.7): let V have locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, Θ^n(μ_V,x) = θ0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0, and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ 1)}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0. Then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is rectifiable and η_{0,s#}C = C (rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure) for all s > 0. (Exactly AllardRectifiabilityTheorem ∧ TangentConesAreRectifiableCones.)
subproblem.natural_proof:
This child proves both conjuncts. PART A is AllardRectifiabilityTheorem (Simon 5.5 with Remark 5.6); PART B is TangentConesAreRectifiableCones (Simon 5.7), whose printed proof uses 5.5, here Part A.

==== PART A: AllardRectifiabilityTheorem (5.5, 5.6).
Source: Simon, Ch. 8, Theorem 5.5, Remark 5.6 and the printed proof of 5.5 (pp. 215–218). ERRATA: in printed (5), “Θ^n(μ_{V_j}, y) ≤ θ0 − ε_j” must read “≥ θ0 − ε_j” (it is the rescaling of (3)); 5.2 is read with centre 0 (μ_C(B_ρ(0))). Details filled in: the use of 3.7 in (3)–(7) is exactly the second conjunct of the sibling varifold_tangents (blow-up density lower bound) applied with τ = θ0 − ε; “(and hence for every y ∈ spt μ_C by 3.4)” is the upper semicontinuity of the density of a stationary varifold; “C = θ0 v(T) by Constancy 4.1” is the sibling constancy with U = ℝ^N, M = T. Notation: μ = μ_V, Θ(y) := Θ^n(μ, y), G = Grassmannian N n, B_ρ(y) closed ball, V_{x,λ} = rescaledMeasure V x λ, v(T) = planeVarifoldMeasure T, ω_n = unitBallVolume n, VarTan(V,x) = {C : IsVarifoldTangent V x C}.

Statement. If V has locally bounded first variation in U and Θ^n(μ, x) exists and is > 0 for μ-a.e. x, then V has a tangent plane in the sense of 1.1 (HasTangentPlane V x T θ for some T, θ) at μ-a.e. x, and V is rectifiable (IsRectifiable V).

STEP A1 (good points, Remark 5.6). Let x satisfy:
 (i) x ∈ U and Θ(x) = θ0 ∈ (0,∞) — μ-a.e. by hypothesis and the sibling monotonicity_density (third conjunct DensityExistsAE: finiteness a.e.), μ(Uᶜ) = 0;
 (ii) the conclusion of Lemma 1.3 at x: η(x) is a probability measure on G and for every β ∈ C(G), ∫_{Gₙ(B_ρ(x))} β dV / μ(B_ρ(x)) → ∫ β dη(x) — μ-a.e. by the sibling plane_disintegration;
 (iii) Θ is μ-approximately continuous at x: with the Borel function Θ̃ of the sibling monotonicity_density (third conjunct DensityExistsAE) (Θ̃ = Θ, finite, μ-a.e.), for every ε > 0, μ({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : |Θ̃(y) − Θ̃(x)| ≥ ε})/μ(B_ρ(x)) → 0 — μ-a.e. by the Lebesgue differentiation theorem for the Radon measure μ on U (Ch. 1 3.16–3.17; Mathlib Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div applied, on a compact exhaustion of U, to the countably many Borel sets {Θ̃ ∈ (a,b)}, a < b rational), together with Θ̃(x) = Θ(x);
 (iv) ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) ≤ Λ(x) μ(B_ρ(x)) for 0 < ρ < ρ0, with ball x ρ0 ⊆ U and Λ(x) < ∞ — μ-a.e. by 2.7 (sibling first_variation; SimonGMT ae_exists_ballFirstVariationBound_inside).
 Conditions (i)–(iv) hold for μ-a.e. x. Fix such an x.

STEP A2 (5.1 holds at x). By (iv) and (i), ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) ≤ Λ(x) ρ · μ(B_ρ(x))/ρ^n = Λ(x) ω_n ρ · densityRatio(ρ) → 0. So by the sibling varifold_tangents (VarifoldTangentCones): every sequence λ_j ↓ 0 has a subsequence along which V_{x,λ_j} converges to some C (in particular VarTan(V,x) ≠ ∅), and every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is stationary in ℝ^N and satisfies
 (1) μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0 ω_n ρ^n for all ρ > 0.
Fix C ∈ VarTan(V,x), along λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0.

STEP A3 (printed (2): Θ^n(μ_C, y) ≤ μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n) ≤ θ0). C is stationary in ℝ^N, so by the sibling monotonicity_density (3.3 with Λ = 0, or the identity 3.4) for every y the ratio ρ ↦ μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n) is non-decreasing on (0,∞) and Θ^n(μ_C, y) exists. For R > 0, B_R(y) ⊆ B_{R+|y|}(0), so by (1): μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n) ≤ μ_C(B_R(y))/(ω_nR^n) ≤ μ_C(B_{R+|y|}(0))/(ω_n(R+|y|)^n)·(1+|y|/R)^n = θ0(1+|y|/R)^n → θ0 as R → ∞. Hence Θ^n(μ_C, y) ≤ μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n) ≤ θ0 for all y and ρ > 0.

STEP A4 (printed (3)–(7): Θ^n(μ_C, ·) ≥ θ0 μ_C-a.e.). Let 0 < ε < θ0 and τ := θ0 − ε. By (iii) and (i): writing E_τ := {y : ¬ ∃ θ, HasDensity n μ y θ ∧ ofReal τ ≤ θ}, we have E_τ ⊆ N ∪ {y : Θ̃(y) < θ0 − ε} with N μ-null (where Θ̃(y) ≠ ∞ ∧ HasDensity n μ y (Θ̃ y) fails), so μ(E_τ ∩ B_ρ(x)) ≤ μ({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : |Θ̃(y) − θ0| ≥ ε}) = o(μ(B_ρ(x))) = o(ρ^n) (μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ 2θ0ω_nρ^n for small ρ). This is printed (3)–(6) (G := {Θ ≥ θ0 − ε}, with the corrected inequality in (5)). Together with 5.1 (Step A2), the second conjunct of the sibling varifold_tangents (the 3.7 argument on rescalings) gives: for μ_C-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_C, y) ≥ θ0 − ε. Intersecting over ε = θ0/k: (7) Θ^n(μ_C, y) ≥ θ0 for μ_C-a.e. y.

STEP A5 (printed “(and hence for every y ∈ spt μ_C by 3.4)”). Upper semicontinuity: for y ∈ spt μ_C there are y_k → y with Θ^n(μ_C, y_k) ≥ θ0 (the set where (7) holds is μ_C-conull, hence dense in spt μ_C); for ρ > 0, by the monotonicity of Step A3 at y_k, Θ^n(μ_C, y_k) ≤ μ_C(B_ρ(y_k))/(ω_nρ^n) ≤ μ_C(B_{ρ+|y_k−y|}(y))/(ω_nρ^n), so θ0 ≤ μ_C(B_{ρ'}(y))/(ω_nρ^n) for every ρ' > ρ, hence (closed balls, continuity from above) θ0 ≤ μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n) for all ρ, and Θ^n(μ_C, y) ≥ θ0. With Step A3: Θ^n(μ_C, y) = θ0 = μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n) for all y ∈ spt μ_C and ρ > 0.

STEP A6 (printed (8): x' − y ∈ S). Fix y ∈ spt μ_C. The sibling monotonicity_density (second conjunct StationaryMonotonicityIdentity for C at centre y, any ρ0) gives Θ^n(μ_C,y) + ω_n^{-1}normalDefect C y (B_ρ(y)) = μ_C(B_ρ(y))/(ω_nρ^n), so by Step A5 normalDefect C y (B_ρ(y)) = 0 for all ρ: p_{S⊥}(x' − y) = 0 for C-a.e. (x', S). As (x',S) ↦ p_{S⊥}(x' − y) is continuous, x' − y ∈ S for every (x',S) ∈ spt C. Hence (8): x' − y ∈ S for all y ∈ spt μ_C and (x',S) ∈ spt C.

STEP A7 (C = θ0 v(T), printed via Constancy 4.1). By (1), μ_C(B_ρ(0)) > 0 for all ρ, so 0 ∈ spt μ_C = π(spt C) (G compact; SimonGMT weight_support_eq_fst_image_support, ConstancyTangentGraph.lean): choose T with (0,T) ∈ spt C. By (8) with (x',S) = (0,T): −y ∈ T, i.e. y ∈ T, for all y ∈ spt μ_C; so spt μ_C ⊆ T. Apply the sibling constancy (ConstancyTheorem) with U = ℝ^N, V = C (stationary), M = T (an n-plane is an n-dimensional C² Simon submanifold via a linear isometric parametrisation ℝ^n → T; T ∩ ℝ^N = T is convex, hence preconnected; classicalTangentSpace T x = T for x ∈ T): C(A) = θ' H^n({x ∈ T : (x,T) ∈ A}) = θ' v(T)(A) for some θ' ≥ 0 (a Grassmannian point is determined by its plane). By (1), θ' ω_n ρ^n = θ0 ω_n ρ^n (H^n(T ∩ B_ρ(0)) = ω_nρ^n), so θ' = θ0: every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is θ0 v(T) for some n-plane T.

STEP A8 (uniqueness, printed (9)). Let θ0 v(T) ∈ VarTan(V,x) along λ_j, and β ∈ C(G). subproblem.title: Compactness Theorem 8.5.8 for rectifiable varifolds
subproblem.statement: If V_j (j ∈ ℕ) are rectifiable n-varifolds (IsRectifiable) on open U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, sup_j(μ_{V_j}(W) + ‖δV_j‖(W)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and Θ^n(μ_{V_j},x) exists and is ≥ 1 for x ∈ U ∖ A_j where μ_{V_j}(A_j ∩ W) → 0 for every W ⊂⊂ U, then some subsequence V_{φ(j)} converges as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) to a rectifiable V with locally bounded first variation, Θ^n(μ_V,·) ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e., and ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_j ‖δV_{φ(j)}‖(W) for every open W ⊂⊂ U. (Exactly CompactnessTheorem.)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon, Ch. 8, Theorem 5.8 (p. 218): “a direct consequence of the Rectifiability 5.5, the Semi-continuity 3.7, and the Compactness Theorem 4.16 of Ch. 1 for Radon measures, and its proof is left to the reader”; the proof below is exactly that combination. ERRATUM (E1): 5.8's “liminf_{j→∞}” is taken along the extracted subsequence (the contract's form; along the full sequence the inequality can fail). The Compactness Theorem 4.16 of Ch. 1 is used in its corrected (second-countable, sequential) form, supplied by the sibling radon_compactness. Notation: μ_j = μ_{V_j} = (Vj j).weight, ‖δV_j‖ = variationMeasure (Vj j), G = Grassmannian N n, W ⊂⊂ U = IsRelCompactOpenIn W U (W open with compact closure in U).

Hypotheses: each V_j rectifiable (not needed below) with locally bounded first variation, sup_j(μ_j(W) + ‖δV_j‖(W)) < ∞ for every W ⊂⊂ U, Θ^n(μ_j, x) exists and is ≥ 1 for x ∈ U ∖ A_j, and μ_j(A_j ∩ W) → 0 for every W ⊂⊂ U.
A1. Local mass bounds. Let K ⊆ U be compact (if K = ∅ there is nothing to prove). Let r := dist(K, ℝ^N ∖ U) > 0 (r := 1 if U = ℝ^N) and W := {y : dist(y,K) < r/2}; W is open and its closure lies in the compact set {y : dist(y,K) ≤ r/2} ⊆ U, so IsRelCompactOpenIn W U, and V_j.measure(K × G) = μ_j(K) ≤ μ_j(W) ≤ C_K := sup_j(μ_j(W) + ‖δV_j‖(W)) < ∞ for every j; this is the (uniform, hence eventual) local mass bound required by radon_compactness.
A2. Extraction (Ch. 1 4.16). The sibling radon_compactness applied to μ_j := V_j.measure (U is open: (Vj 0).isOpen_domain; A1 supplies its local mass hypothesis) gives a strictly increasing φ and V : Varifold N n U with ∫ f dV_{φ(j)} → ∫ f dV for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) with tsupport f ⊆ U × G.
A3. Radon convergence on Gₙ(U). Every f ∈ C_c(U ×ˢ univ, ℝ) extends by zero to f̃ ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) with tsupport f̃ ⊆ U × G (its support is a compact subset of the open set U × G), and ∫ f d(V_j).domainMeasure = ∫ f̃ dV_j.measure (V_j.measure = domainMeasure.map Subtype.val, Varifold.map_domainMeasure). Hence Varifold.RadonConverges (fun j ↦ V_{φ(j)}) V.
A4. Semicontinuity (3.7). Apply the sibling density_semicontinuity to the sequence V_{φ(i)}, the limit V and the sets B_i := A_{φ(i)}: RadonConverges (A3); each V_{φ(i)} has LBFV; liminf_i ‖δV_{φ(i)}‖(W) ≤ sup_j ‖δV_j‖(W) < ∞; Θ^n(μ_{φ(i)}, y) ≥ 1 on U ∖ B_i; μ_{φ(i)}(B_i ∩ W) → 0 (subsequence of a null sequence; W ⊂⊂ U ranges over open sets with compact closure in U). Conclusions: V has LBFV, ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_i ‖δV_{φ(i)}‖(W) for every open W ⊂⊂ U (E1), and Θ^n(μ_V, x) exists and is ≥ 1 for μ_V-a.e. x.
A5. Rectifiability (5.5). Since Θ^n(μ_V,·) ≥ 1 > 0 μ_V-a.e., the sibling allard_tangent_cones (first conjunct, AllardRectifiabilityTheorem) gives IsRectifiable V. This proves CompactnessTheorem.
proof_key_steps: Local mass bounds on compact subsets of U from the sup hypothesis; radon_compactness extracts a subsequence and a limit varifold V.
Extension by zero of test functions on Gₙ(U) gives RadonConverges (V_{φ(j)}) V.
density_semicontinuity (3.7) along the subsequence: V has LBFV, ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_{j'} ‖δV_{j'}‖(W) (erratum: liminf along the subsequence) and Θ^n(μ_V,·) ≥ 1 a.e.
Allard's theorem 5.5 (allard_tangent_cones, first conjunct) gives IsRectifiable V.

subproblem.title: Allard's Integral Compactness Theorem 8.5.9 (with corrected Lemma 5.10 and repaired conclusion)
subproblem.statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^N be open and V_j (j ∈ ℕ) integer multiplicity rectifiable n-varifolds on U (IsIntegral: V_j = v(M_j, θ_j) with θ_j ∈ ℕ H^n-a.e. on M_j) with locally bounded first variation and sup_j(μ_{V_j}(W) + ‖δV_j‖(W)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Then (i) some subsequence V_{φ(j)} (φ strictly increasing) converges as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) to an integral V with locally bounded first variation and ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_j ‖δV_{φ(j)}‖(W) for every open W ⊂⊂ U; and (ii) for every strictly increasing φ and every V with V_{φ(j)} → V as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) (RadonConverges), V is integral. (Exactly IntegralCompactnessTheorem.)
subproblem.natural_proof:
